disciplines.html:
HMC will aid you throughout your product development strategy from day one. The goal is to provide data systems, advice, and solutions to accelerate the device's go-to-market process, while ensuring product quality and compliance. If you do not know how to start, HMC will be the one to help you find information and present you with answers.

Product development consulting

With decades of experience, HMC is proud to be a leader in consulting and providing solutions to accelerate product development for customers in many healthcare fields such as: medical device, pharmaceutical and pharmaceutical industries, and  Biopharmaceuticals. We have the resources and supports with R&D centers and other major laboratories around the world to best serve you.

Areas where HMC can assist you:

Medicine:

Know what medications you need, what tests orders should be ordered, and other questions you may have. Our regulatory strategy service will answer questions about the applicability of the subsequent to your product:

● Submission before visiting market

● Global requirements to enter the market

● Other relevant questions that are not included above.

Biological

For young and start-up businesses, overcoming regulatory requirements to commercialize structured products (such as biological products) can be challenging and overwhelming. We can help get your product to the global market faster by following these appropriate guidelines below:

● IND

Medical devices

Did any barriers arise when entering the specified market of your medical device?

HMC can check and provide solutions in the most professional way. We have the database and world-class expertise to back you up with confidence. In HMC's strategic service, you can get support such as:

● Required submission types like 510(k), PMA, De Novo, HDE,

● Performance test request

● International performance standards

● Global requirements to enter the market

By choosing and collaborating with HMC, your products will be brought to the desired market faster. Contact us immediately for efficient results.

disciplines.title: Clinical
disciplines.html:
Project Management

In order for your clinical trial to be successful, it’s necessary you will need a professional project administrator. We have the best project managers in the field, with frequent up to date training to ensure your trials are fast and efficient. When working with HMC, you can rest assured that there are experts on hand to answer your questions and provide meticulous and dedicated support at all times. The jobs of a senior project manager that we have include:

● Develop a specific research plan to thoroughly manage and monitor each project, as well as monitor risk management

● Narrow down all research needs at the local level - including central labs, warehouses and other third parties (on request)

● Organize, plan and hold investigator meetings

● Continuous project status tracking, with comprehensive and transparent client reporting

● Negotiate budgets and execute contracts with research sites to provide the most cost-effective option.

● conduct initial and regular research group meetings, to ensure effective planning, organization, and conduct of research

● Manage all research related issues in all phases of the trial

Clinical Operation

1. STUDY START-UP

 With its expertise, HMC will help make your tests a success. We'll work out effective participant sign-up strategies, quick processes, and efficient venue selection to make your trial go as fast as possible with minimal to no complications.

 Our top criteria is to: save time and costs but still ensure efficiency in the workflow. With decades of working experience, HMC ensures the testing process always runs on and ahead of schedule, while minimizing any potential risks. Here is our system of focus points to give you an overview of your startup:

● Evidence-based feasibility

● Carefully evaluated and selected position

● Identify and evaluate potential bottlenecks to create effective risk reduction strategies

● Clinical trial validation and legal documentation

● Collect and review site management documents

● Procurement of regulatory and/or ethics committee approvals

● Organize and hold investigator meetings

● Website initialization and rapid audience recruitment

 2. CLINICAL MONITORING

Your test will be a great success under our CRA monitoring team. HMC's CRA experts are always available at the test site for monitoring, wherever it takes place. All activities follow ICH GCP process, research protocol, monitoring plan and client's expectations. We will continuously update information, reviews and support 24/7.

What we offer our partners:

● Visits start the site

● Frequent site monitoring visits

● Site management and easy access - including regular site contact via phone, email, etc.

● Monitor the query resolution process

● Website support during database locking

● Research observational visits

If you need more than the points listed above, HMC has a custom service that ensures a good fit. Contact us now.

 3. SITE MANAGEMENT

You need professional site management to make the trial process efficient and get results quickly.

 HMC's CRA is highly trained and available 24/7. We are adept at building long-term partnerships with investigators and supporting effective trial recruitment, as well as ensuring consistent data quality and consistency.

Resources and tools that HMC offers you during your studies are:

● Training and educating site staff

● Research of drug and non-drug supply logistics

● Keeping track of regulatory document revisions

● Monitoring protocol deviations

● Subject state tracking in trials

 4. SAFETY MONITORING

 Keeping patient safety and reducing risk should always be the first priority.

 In our staff development strategy, there are always safety and therapy areas and pieces of training. HMC medical monitors are available 24/7.

 In our staff development strategy, we provide safety areas as well as therapy options for our training. HMC medical monitors are available 24/7.

 Strategic services that HMC provides:

● Medical supervision planning

● Performance of medical surveillance inclusion/exclusion criteria

● Therapy area training for CRA and PM

● Assistance in SAE (Serious Adverse Event) reports to investigators

● Interaction with the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB)

● Distribution of secure information reasonably among investigators

● Announce safety notice to regulatory authorities and/or ethics committee

 5. CLINICAL TRIAL LOGISTICS

To make your trial go smoothly, our clinical trial logistics will:

● Apply for import and export permits from regulatory agencies

● Prepare customs documents

● Import research products, comparators, and research materials, including laboratory kits and any specific equipment

● Store, distribute, relabel, return, and destroy investigative materials/equipment.

● Export biological samples from clinical sites to the central laboratory

● Management of courier services

With industry-leading experts and extensive relationships, we always support you wholeheartedly.

 6. VENDORS' MANAGEMENT

If you find it difficult to understand the risks, relationships, or other policies in connection with laboratories and warehouses, then simplify things by working with HMC. We have strong relationships with all parties: quality assurance, advanced technology, and full certifications. The associates of HMC have always been reputable in clinical trials and enthusiastic support at all times.

Data Management

Data management in clinical trials is a necessary step to ensure accurate and reliable data are obtained.

HMC's team of experts are always qualified to provide the following services:

● Participate in designs of Research Protocols to ensure that data is appropriately Collected and managed

● Develop Data Management Plans

● Develop CFR and EDC according to CDISC, SDTM, CDASH standards

● Performance of data validation activities, including: Project-specific Editing, Test Specifications, Data Validation Plan, automated test programming, input masking, and data review.

● Develop a Data Transfer Plan

● Data entry and CRF tracking for paper CRF

● User training for EDC system and CRF completion rules

● Load data from external sources (central lab, ECG, etc.)

● Integrate the drug delivery and randomization (IWRS) module directly into the EDC . system

● Quality control of imported data

● Data cleaning operations for temporary and final database locking

● Prepare data management reports for quality control and metrics measurement

● Medical coding using MeDRA, WHODD and SAE collation

Biostatics

Biostatistics in clinical research

You will always receive real and timely data. Using advanced tools and techniques, HMC provides strategic services:

● Design clinical study protocols, including statistical input

● Sample size calculation

● Create Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP)

● Develop analytical datasets, as well as tables, figures, and list templates (TFLs)

● Generate random diagrams

● Create drug labeling lists

● Statistical SAS programming

● Central data monitoring throughout the study

● Statistical data analysis

● Prepare mid-year and end-of-year statistical reports

● Analysis after the lesson

● CDISC mapping and transformation

Quality Assurance

With this service package, you can rest assured that your implementation and monitoring processes are always up to the highest international standards.

The HMC team will show you the most comprehensive and unbiased assessment of your ongoing processes, and offer valuable advice on how to maximize your potential, doubling your surplus and value test treatment.

Our managers can establish a plan to organize contract audits and provide a range of clinical trial consulting services.

disciplines.title: Regulatory
disciplines.html:
Regulatory Strategy

Each product has a certain regulatory strategy. With its expertise, HMCwill provide you with an overview and detailed roadmap to help you visualize the path from research to commercialization. We will provide you with all the information to keep your progress on track and create your own financial plan.

Many of our team members are former FDA officials or former executives of leading pharmaceutical/medical device companies spanning the world. They all converge to help you have the most suitable regulatory strategy, making the path to commercialization of your product more simple.

For pharmaceuticals

We'll clarify what tests and standards you need to meet, meanwhile setting you up with a standard process to help bring your drugs to market. We also provide solutiosn for the following:

● Pre-IND and IND

● Submission before going to market

● Submitted first

● Clinical investigation.

● Global requirements to enter the market

For biological products

Regulations on probiotics are  getting increasingly complex overtime. The HMC team will advise you comprehensively to ensure that your product always passes the following tests, and other recent regulations:

● Pre-IND and IND

● Access is extended

● Submission to the market

● Send BLA

● Global requirements to enter the market

● Other prerequisites for getting your product to consumers

 For medical equipment

 Device type, availability of predicate devices, and technology all affect licensing and  liquidation of medical devices. HMC will help you understand how and what to submit to the licensing authority. We also advise on the following:

● Requester type (IDE, 510(k), PMA, De Novo, HUD & HDE)

● Should you apply for the FDA's Breakthrough Device Designation?

● Performance test request

● International performance standards

● Global requirements to enter the market

Your path to commercialization of your medical product will be on the right track when contacting us. 

Regulatory Submission

Submission before commercialization is the last but not least step in determining your success. Your next business goals and plans will be guaranteed by the full preparation from HMC. Whether you're manufacturing medical devices, pharmaceuticals or biopharmaceuticals, we have a wide comprehension of the submission and preparation process. In addition to using stand-alone services, you can also combine them with an entire regulatory strategy. You'll be guaranteed accurate, timely submissions that streamline your path to approval and clearance.

 For medical equipment/Digital Health:

1. Exemption before equipment investigation

We help you understand and tailor FDA requirements. We provide services like pre-packaging your IDE, if applicable, thus ensuring you get valuable feedback from the FDA.

2. Investigative Device Exemption (IDE)

Ensure you are ready for your clinical investigation by preparing your investigation submission package.

3. Q-Send

4. 510(k) / Pre-Market Approval (PMA) / DeNovo / Humanitarian Device Exemption (HDE)

For pharmaceuticals:

1. Pre-IND

Milestone for bringing your drug to market. HMC will work with you to understand and tailor FDA requirements and prepare a pre-IND package to ensure you get valuable FDA feedback.

2. Investigational New Drug Application (IND)

We will prepare a comprehensive IND so you can begin your clinical investigation.

3. ANDA / NDA

We will help you draft a new drug application or abbreviated prescription to ensure the commercialization of the drug.

For biopharmaceuticals

1. New drug exemption / pre-investigation equipment

 We help you understand and tailor FDA requirements. Pre package your IDE, if applicable, thus enabling you to get valuable feedback from the FDA.

2. IND or IDE

We'll help you prepare the right investigative submission package, so you're ready to take on your clinical investigation

3. Biological Licensing Application (BLA)

We will compile the BLA in a neat and professional manner. In addition, we will link up with relevant parties and follow up so that your profile can be approved quickly. 

FDA 

As an industry leader, HMC will help you navigate FDA regulations and achieve compliance. We offer a wide range of capabilities such as product submission, GXP training, clinical and non-technical development, program design, product evaluation, and system monitoring. With our extensive expertise, HMC will help your product get to market quickly.

IVDR

Compared to IVD, IVDR (In vitro diagnostic regulation) is gaining more favor due to its transparent calculations and ability to maintain sustainability. With its team of scientists, HMC can advise you:

● Strategically convert from IVDD to IVDR

● Identify the list that needs to be prioritized for consideration

● Update technical documents in accordance with regulations

● Setting up a quality management system and navigation

Market Research

A worldwide network of partners and decades of data are the keys to HMC helping you explore your market.

HMC has decades of data experience and a worldwide network of partners. These connections and knowledge are the keys in helping you explore your market.

HMC has vast resources to help you access regulatory, quality, and compliance expertise of the pharmaceutical, biological, and medical device industries, wherever you are. Leave a question or speak to our experts right away to find out what you need in product development and commercialization. HMC listens and offers the most appropriate, exclusive solution.

We always strive to create the ideal conditions for startups to reach out to the world. Let's join the network of HMC.

disciplines.title: Post-Market
disciplines.html:
Post Market Compliance

From assisting with product development and initial submission preparation, HMC creates a corresponding support program to help you bypass warning letters and take corrective actions. You can use the service alone, or with our extensive experience, we always handle every case. Timely, sustainable and economical are our operating principles.

We support projects of all sizes in the life sciences. Our compliance consulting services include:

● 483 comments

● Feedback warning letter

● Remedial strategy

● Labeling and rating the site

● Test analysis and distance

● Fake FDA inspection

● Remedial measures

If you need to support proactive after-market activities, HMC also has a support team available. Services include:

● Pharmacovigilance

● Test Ready Training

● Expert theme support

● Post-market clinical follow-up (PMCF)

● Global vigilance support  

Post Market Surveillance

Acceptance is not the end of your success, the next step is to maintain compliance with ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820. You will need to participate in after-sales monitoring activities to further monitor the safety and effectiveness of the medical devices you sell.

 HMC will help you:

● Medical device risk management

● System tuning and optimization

● Develop a PMS plan

We will rely on your market to offer the most suitable solution.
